scope: Exact-token world/data source references; not live spawn or acquisition coverage.

blueprints.name: Chest
blueprints.resolved_text: A hinged lid closes over a deep storage box. The frame is reinforced at the corners.

blueprints.name: WellmeetGuestLocker
blueprints.resolved_text: A guest locker beneath the cloth. Claim it while your guest-right holds; afterward the same chest remains available when the oath expires.

blueprints.name: QuillholdLoanShelf
blueprints.resolved_text: Two utility volumes are lent for Ink. Study grants their ordinary permanent knowledge. Return one book for the stated partial Ink refund, or buy out your exact loan in drams.

blueprints.name: TentWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Woven goat-hair, dense enough to keep the noon out. The wall of a house that moves.

blueprints.name: FrontierClothScreen
blueprints.resolved_text: An abandoned screen still interrupts the view. Strip it for two lengths of knotflax cord and the cover is gone.

blueprints.name: SoddenRouteNotice
blueprints.resolved_text: Cutters have left a route notice above the wet line. The shelter, crossing and abandoned works form a short southern circuit below Sumphold.

blueprints.name: SoddenPassagePost
blueprints.resolved_text: A short dry crossing is watched from this post. Four drams buy one local passage. The longer dry boardwalks and the wet crossing remain open.

blueprints.name: SoddenPassageGuard
blueprints.resolved_text: This watcher guards only the marked cutbank. Pay before entering, take the longer boards, or wade. A passage does not excuse a personal attack.

blueprints.name: VillageDoor
blueprints.resolved_text: A fitted panel swings on hinges. A simple latch holds it closed.

blueprints.name: SpreadFieldGate
blueprints.resolved_text: Timber rails hang between short posts. A plain latch rests below the top rail.

blueprints.name: FrontierPenGate
blueprints.resolved_text: An ordinary gate keeps the grazer from the outside forage row. Open it and the animal can follow the real path out.

blueprints.name: CounterStoreChest
blueprints.resolved_text: Old counter stock remains behind a keyed lock. A key, a nearby locksmith, or breaking the box will expose the same finite goods.

blueprints.name: CausticFilm
blueprints.resolved_text: A thin conjured acid film. Anything crossing it is coated in acid. It fades after four turns and cannot be gathered.

blueprints.name: MarlbackScrabbler
blueprints.resolved_text: A short-faced bank burrower with a broad back of overlapping shale plates. Its grasping foreclaws rake loose earth into low walls around the burrow mouth.

blueprints.name: MarlbackStormbinder
blueprints.resolved_text: This marlback carries a spark root in a dry pouch beneath blue-stained shale plates. It soaks a clear target, then sends lightning along the same line. Break its sight, dry off, or close while its spells recover. It keeps a little distance, steps around blocked shots, and will spend time recovering its own dropped cudgel.

blueprints.name: MarlbackCorpse
blueprints.resolved_text: Overlapping shale plates lie slack above short limbs and broad digging claws. Mud still fills the seams of the bank burrower’s back.

blueprints.name: MarlbackStormbinderCorpse
blueprints.resolved_text: Blue-stained shale plates are folded over the still claws of a stormbinder. The dry pouch and any unspent supplies fell with their owner.

blueprints.name: FieldHaftComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: A shaped length of salvaged timber. Strength modifier cap 1; no hit or penetration bonus.

blueprints.name: PlainCordBindingComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: A plain knotflax lashing. Fits a forged weapon; no hit or penetration bonus.

blueprints.name: TepuiboneHeadComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: Sandstone patiently cut from tepuibone into a small striking head. Cudgel family; 1d3 damage and -1 penetration. No reach bonus.

blueprints.name: BracedHaftComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: Bracing carries a strong wielder's force at the cost of precision. Strength modifier cap 5; -1 hit.

blueprints.name: GuardLashingComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: A close balanced lashing. +2 hit, -1 penetration; no extra armor or reach.

blueprints.name: FilterHood
blueprints.resolved_text: Wear on your head instead of a helmet. Filters 50 points of respiratory intake and reduces typed gas damage by 10%. It is not gas immunity, armor, or a cure for existing poison. Its leather fastening seams can be repaired with one leather binding when damaged.

blueprints.name: AcidworkerApron
blueprints.resolved_text: A sealed work apron. Body AV 1, DV -1, speed -5; +50 acid resistance while worn. Other damage is unchanged, and one-point acid hits still hurt. Its leather fastening seams can be repaired with one leather binding when damaged.

blueprints.name: ColdwardCloak
blueprints.resolved_text: A heavy-folded coldward cloak. Back AV 0, DV -1; +50 cold resistance while worn. Replaces your other back garment; no immunity. Its leather fastening seams can be repaired with one leather binding when damaged.

blueprints.name: KnotflaxBandage
blueprints.resolved_text: Apply one bandage to stop ordinary bleeding. No healing, poison cure or lasting protection. Application spends the bandage even when no bleeding is present.

blueprints.name: ConcentratedMendleaf
blueprints.resolved_text: Two sprigs reduced to one portable measure. Brew into one 2d4 healing draught instead of two separate 1d4 draughts.

blueprints.name: CleansedGrovePulp
blueprints.resolved_text: Processed grove-red: toxic character removed, original vital potency reduced to 2. Brew for 2d4 healing.

blueprints.name: SoddenDressingBench
blueprints.resolved_text: A split-legged dressing bench with a cloth clamp and a bitter-leaf press. Sella needs two sound timber lengths to brace it. The abandoned cutting works lie two stretches east, beyond the cutbank crossing. Once repaired, the keeper wraps one sumpsieve pad and one knotflax cord into a field dressing for two drams. Dressings treat existing ordinary poison and bleeding; they do not protect against marsh gas.

blueprints.name: RepairTimberPile
blueprints.resolved_text: Four sound lengths can be pried from this collapsed frame. Gather them for wooden repairs.

blueprints.name: SoddenWorksSalvage
blueprints.resolved_text: Four sound timber lengths remain in this abandoned drying frame. Harvest them once. Two will brace the dressing bench at the shelter two stretches west; sound timber also serves other wooden repairs and mechanical trap jamming.

blueprints.name: SoddenWorksLocker
blueprints.resolved_text: An iron-banded locker survives above the old wet line. Its remaining equipment and cord can be taken; nobody replenishes these abandoned stores. Leather boots and a buckler offer their usual armor, not immunity to mire or marsh gas.

blueprints.name: SoddenFieldDressing
blueprints.resolved_text: Sumpsieve folded into a tight knotflax wrap. Apply it to remove existing ordinary poison and bleeding together. A dressing is used only when one of those conditions is present. It does not restore health, cure gas poisoning or fungal infection, or protect against future exposure.

blueprints.name: SpreadCookingCoals
blueprints.resolved_text: A shallow bed of leftover cooking coals. Its remaining heat will fade.

blueprints.name: Bone
blueprints.resolved_text: A pale length of bone, worn smooth on the outside and porous at its broken end.

blueprints.name: GoldCoin
blueprints.resolved_text: A small gold coin with a worn rim. The stamped face has been rubbed down to a shallow relief.

blueprints.name: InkVial
blueprints.resolved_text: Stoppered squid-dark ink. The quartermasters take payment in it; the scribes never seem to run out.

blueprints.name: Dagger
blueprints.resolved_text: A short blade with a close-fitting grip. The point has been kept sharp.

blueprints.name: Shrine
blueprints.resolved_text: A low stone shelf under a lean-to, set with smooth stones, candle stubs and a bowl with a few coins in it. Whose shrine it is depends on who you ask. Everyone agrees it is a good place to stop.

blueprints.name: Rubble
blueprints.resolved_text: Broken stone lies in a loose scatter, with sharp fresh faces among the weathered pieces.

blueprints.name: MarlbackGleaner
blueprints.resolved_text: Discarded cutting tools sit between this marlback’s shale back plates. It works the river wrack with a blunt snout and quick grasping claws, retreating toward its burrow when pressed.

blueprints.name: MarlbackPatchbearer
blueprints.resolved_text: Pale straps cross this marlback's shale plates. A little open cradle sits within reach of its grasping claws, padded with old cloth; its cutting tools are kept farther back. The harness has been patched far more carefully than its owner's scars.

blueprints.name: MarlbackTunnelguard
blueprints.resolved_text: This short-faced marlback braces a salvaged pole across the passage. Pale shale plates overlap its broad back; hooked digging claws grip the wet bank beneath it. If disarmed, it spends separate actions retrieving and re-equipping its own weapon; taking that weapon away denies the recovery.

blueprints.name: Starapple
blueprints.resolved_text: A round fruit with firm skin and a small, star-shaped crown at the stem.

blueprints.name: HealingTonic
blueprints.resolved_text: A medicinal dose in a small stoppered vessel. Its label is worn where a thumb finds the grip.

blueprints.name: PoisonTonic
blueprints.resolved_text: A tightly stoppered dose with a sharply marked warning. The contents are meant to be handled more carefully than ordinary medicine.

blueprints.name: FireTonic
blueprints.resolved_text: A flame mark runs up the side of the vessel. The stopper has been tied down for travel.

blueprints.name: PeatMalletHeadComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: Cutters around Sumphold pack peat with this broad iron-faced head. Forged as a cudgel, its bludgeoning blows can stun and it supports learned cudgel skills. It trades damage and armor penetration for control: head damage 1d4, penetration -1. Add a haft and binding in the Crafting tab. The abandoned works east of the cutbank kept these with their pump screens.

blueprints.name: CinderhookAxeHeadComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: A heavy hooked edge from Cinderhold extraction crews, sold by the workshop smith. Assemble it with a haft and binding to use learned axe skills. The hook bites hard but pulls a swing wide: head damage 1d8, hit -2. A steadier haft or binding can offset that cost; the crafting preview shows the final weapon.

blueprints.name: CounterweightLongBladeComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: Last Counter keeps these slender frontier blades in its supply-post chest. A brass counterweight steadies the point; the thin edge struggles against armor. Head damage 1d6, hit +1, penetration -1. A haft and binding make a long blade for learned stances and Lunge. The weapon does not teach those skills.

blueprints.name: KilnfeltApron
blueprints.resolved_text: Cinderhold kiln workers stitch mineral felt beneath overlapping red patches. Worn on the body, it gives 50 heat resistance but only 1 armor and slows you by 5. It sacrifices physical protection for fire and steam work; it does not protect against poison gas, acid, cold or electricity. The workshop smith sells the apron beside the cinderhook heads.

blueprints.name: GroundwireScreen
blueprints.resolved_text: A handgrip and insulated backing have been fitted to the copper mesh once used to earth peatworks pumps. It gives 50 electrical resistance while held, occupying a hand that could carry a shield or weapon. The open mesh gives no armor or dodge bonus and does not protect against mire acid or poison. Spare screens remain in the abandoned works locker east of the cutbank.

blueprints.name: SteelBladeComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: An unmounted steel blade with a bare tang. It can become a long blade at a forge, or supply metal to repair damaged metal gear.

blueprints.name: IronSpikeComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: An iron point with a thick base left for mounting. Its narrow tip concentrates the force of a thrust.

blueprints.name: OakHaftComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: A straight oak haft, shaped at one end to receive a weapon head. The grain runs along its length.

blueprints.name: WillowHaftComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: A slim willow haft with a smoothly pared grip. The mounting end is still bare.

blueprints.name: LeatherBindingComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: A long strip of leather cut for a firm winding. It can bind a weapon grip or help repair damaged leather gear.

blueprints.name: SerratedEdgeComponent
blueprints.resolved_text: A set of close-set teeth and fastenings for dressing an edge. It is a finishing component, not a blade by itself.

blueprints.name: AlchemyStill
blueprints.resolved_text: A receiving vessel sits below a coiled condenser. The still separates a mixture one patient drop at a time.

blueprints.name: TinkersForge
blueprints.resolved_text: A hearth and work surface share the same worn reach. Fitting a blade, haft and binding here makes a working weapon.

blueprints.name: FireMoss
blueprints.resolved_text: A warm, brittle mat of moss. Loose crumbs catch with a tiny spark.

blueprints.name: LampOil
blueprints.resolved_text: A slow, greasy oil that clings to its container. It serves both the still and a torch in need of fuel.

blueprints.name: EmberFruit
blueprints.resolved_text: The flesh holds a lingering warmth beneath its sweetness. Alchemists keep it among their heating ingredients.

blueprints.name: FrostLichen
blueprints.resolved_text: Rime outlines the little fronds. Even a brief touch leaves an ache in the fingertips.

blueprints.name: GlacierSalt
blueprints.resolved_text: Large, cold crystals fit tightly against one another. When crushed, they leave a fine binding powder.

blueprints.name: GlimmerBrine
blueprints.resolved_text: The brine gives off a sharp smell. A faint hum follows the vessel when it is moved.

blueprints.name: SparkRoot
blueprints.resolved_text: Fine root-hairs stand around the severed end. Nearby loose hairs rise to meet them.

blueprints.name: VenomGland
blueprints.resolved_text: A small gland with its duct still attached. The swollen part holds what the fang once delivered.

blueprints.name: BogSap
blueprints.resolved_text: Thick sap draws into reluctant threads. Its sour smell persists after the container is closed.

blueprints.name: CandyHeartRoot
blueprints.resolved_text: A thick heartroot with a faint, slow beat. Its mild taste gives little warning of the life in it.

blueprints.name: MendleafSprig
blueprints.resolved_text: Small bruised leaves curl around the stem. The torn edges are drawing together again.

blueprints.name: StoneburrSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: A hard seed with a knuckled shell. Its crushed substance binds into a close, stiff mass.

blueprints.name: BlastcapSpore
blueprints.resolved_text: A gathered blastcap spore, kept apart from heat and careless shaking.

blueprints.name: CandyCarrotSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: A pale seed, faintly sweet-smelling, the size of a fingernail. Plant it in soft ground.

blueprints.name: EmberwheatSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: A warm golden grain that never quite cools. Plant it in soft ground.

blueprints.name: CandyCarrotCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: Gladroot grows below a low spray of leaves. The edible part stays tucked beneath the growing bed.

blueprints.name: EmberwheatCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: A cultivated grain with narrow leaves and upright stalks. Its heads fill as the plant matures.

blueprints.name: CandyCarrot
blueprints.resolved_text: Crisp and orange and honest about it. Grown, not made.

blueprints.name: WateringGrimoire
blueprints.resolved_text: A damp-smelling tome whose ink never quite dries. Its pages describe how to call small, polite rainclouds down onto growing things.

blueprints.name: ToastedEmberwheat
blueprints.resolved_text: Toasted emberwheat, dry and crisp.

blueprints.name: Emberwheat
blueprints.resolved_text: A sheaf of grain that glows faintly warm, even at night.

blueprints.name: InertSludge
blueprints.resolved_text: Stable compost sold by seed keepers and the Morrowfast provisioner. Carry one unit to a freshly planted crop in a prepared bed and choose compost before any wet growth. Once per crop, it shortens each growth stage by 25 percent. It supplies no water; water the crop afterward.

blueprints.name: AcidTonic
blueprints.resolved_text: A narrow vessel with an acid warning on its wrapping. The mouth is kept well clear of the grip.

blueprints.name: LightningTonic
blueprints.resolved_text: A branching mark identifies the dose. Its wrapping leaves only the neck exposed.

blueprints.name: FrostTonic
blueprints.resolved_text: A pale frost mark is worked around the neck. The stopper fits below a tightly wound band.

blueprints.name: WaterTonic
blueprints.resolved_text: A rounded water mark identifies the stoppered dose. The vessel is small enough to hold in one hand.

blueprints.name: BleedTonic
blueprints.resolved_text: A red cut-mark runs across the label. The dose is sealed beneath a close-fitting stopper.

blueprints.name: Antidote
blueprints.resolved_text: A measured remedy with its name written plainly. The stopper is broad enough for an unsteady hand.

blueprints.name: BurnSalve
blueprints.resolved_text: A thick preparation kept beneath a close lid. A flat scrap tucked into the wrapping serves for spreading it.

blueprints.name: Panacea
blueprints.resolved_text: A carefully sealed remedy, its label crowded by the names of several ailments.

blueprints.name: LeatherArmor
blueprints.resolved_text: Panels of thick leather are joined where the body needs to bend. The fastening straps show repeated use.

blueprints.name: ChainMail
blueprints.resolved_text: Small metal rings overlap in a flexible mesh. Their weight gathers wherever the garment folds.

blueprints.name: Sand
blueprints.resolved_text: Fine grains collect in the shallow hollows; the higher ridges have been swept nearly smooth.

blueprints.name: SandstoneWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Packed grains show through the worn face of the stone. Its layers make faint bands across the wall.

blueprints.name: Rock
blueprints.resolved_text: An uneven mass of stone, broad enough to interrupt the path around it.

blueprints.name: Grass
blueprints.resolved_text: Narrow blades crowd the ground, bending over older growth at their roots.

blueprints.name: VineWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Interwoven stems have thickened into a wall. More growth knots around the older strands.

blueprints.name: Tree
blueprints.resolved_text: A woody trunk rises from a spread of roots. Branches fill the space above it.

blueprints.name: StoneFloor
blueprints.resolved_text: The exposed stone has been worn smoother along the places feet keep finding.

blueprints.name: Chair
blueprints.resolved_text: A seat and back are joined above a set of legs. The places hands rest are worn smooth.

blueprints.name: Bed
blueprints.resolved_text: Straw fills the sleeping place. The top has been pressed flat and gathered up again.

blueprints.name: StoneWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Close-set stone fills the space from side to side. Small chips have gathered at its foot.

blueprints.name: LimestoneWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Pale stone, dull on its weathered face and lighter where a corner has chipped away.

blueprints.name: ShaleWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Thin dark layers lie pressed together. At the broken edges they separate like pages.

blueprints.name: SlateWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Dense, dark stone with flat cleavage lines and a faint blue cast.

blueprints.name: QuartziteWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Small bright grains are locked into a hard, uneven face. They catch the light at different angles.

blueprints.name: ObsidianWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Dark volcanic glass curves around old fractures. The broken edges have a much finer line than the weathered face.

blueprints.name: SandstoneFloor
blueprints.resolved_text: A granular stone surface with shallow hollows where softer bands have worn away.

blueprints.name: LimestoneFloor
blueprints.resolved_text: Pale stone underfoot, marked by a loose dust that gathers in its small pits.

blueprints.name: ShaleFloor
blueprints.resolved_text: Flat flakes overlap along the dark stone. Their exposed edges give the surface a ragged grain.

blueprints.name: SlateFloor
blueprints.resolved_text: Broad, close-fitting planes of dark stone make a surface broken by narrow seams.

blueprints.name: QuartziteFloor
blueprints.resolved_text: The stone is speckled with hard pale grains. Worn patches interrupt its rougher surface.

blueprints.name: ObsidianFloor
blueprints.resolved_text: Black glass shows dull patches of wear between curved, reflective fractures.

blueprints.name: StairsDown
blueprints.resolved_text: The treads descend beyond the lip of the opening. Their edges have rounded under passing feet.

blueprints.name: StairsUp
blueprints.resolved_text: A close flight of steps rises toward the opening above. The middle of each tread is worn.

blueprints.name: LongSword
blueprints.resolved_text: A long, straight blade balanced above a plain crossguard.

blueprints.name: Battleaxe
blueprints.resolved_text: A broad axe head sits on a reinforced haft. The cutting edge curves away from the socket.

blueprints.name: Greatsword
blueprints.resolved_text: A large blade with room for both hands on the hilt. Its reach begins well beyond the grip.

blueprints.name: ShortSword
blueprints.resolved_text: A compact sword with a straight edge and enough grip to keep the hand behind the guard.

blueprints.name: Mace
blueprints.resolved_text: A heavy head on a short haft. Its raised faces concentrate the weight of a blow.

blueprints.name: Spear
blueprints.resolved_text: A narrow point extends from a long shaft. The join is bound close beneath the head.

blueprints.name: Hatchet
blueprints.resolved_text: A short haft carries a wedge-shaped head. The back of the blade is thick enough to take a knock.

blueprints.name: Claymore
blueprints.resolved_text: A broad sword with a long grip and a guard that spreads well clear of the blade.

blueprints.name: Cudgel
blueprints.resolved_text: A stout club, heavier at the striking end and smoothed where a hand holds it.

blueprints.name: Buckler
blueprints.resolved_text: A small shield with a raised centre and a grip behind it.

blueprints.name: IronHelmet
blueprints.resolved_text: A worked iron shell with an opening for the face. The rim has been turned away from the skin.

blueprints.name: LeatherBoots
blueprints.resolved_text: Supple leather boots with thicker soles and reinforced seams around the toes.

blueprints.name: LeatherGloves
blueprints.resolved_text: Close-fitting gloves with extra leather across the palms.

blueprints.name: LeatherCap
blueprints.resolved_text: A fitted leather cap, stitched in curved panels to follow the head.

blueprints.name: IronshodBoots
blueprints.resolved_text: Iron strengthens the soles of these boots. Scuffs mark the places that meet the ground first.

blueprints.name: WardedCloak
blueprints.resolved_text: Fine stitching follows the edges of this cloak. The repeated pattern continues around the fastening.

blueprints.name: IronBuckler
blueprints.resolved_text: A compact iron shield. Its turned rim leaves a shallow bowl behind the face.

blueprints.name: PlateArmor
blueprints.resolved_text: Shaped plates overlap at the joints, with straps holding each section against the body.

blueprints.name: Cloak
blueprints.resolved_text: A broad piece of cloth with a fastening at the neck. Its hem carries the wear of travel.

blueprints.name: SpeedTonic
blueprints.resolved_text: The dose bears a small running figure. Creases in its wrapping converge beneath the stopper.

blueprints.name: StrengthTonic
blueprints.resolved_text: A clenched hand marks the vessel. The dose is secured with a short, stout tie.

blueprints.name: StoneskinTonic
blueprints.resolved_text: A stone pattern is drawn around the label. The vessel itself is small enough to fit in a palm.

blueprints.name: Mushroom
blueprints.resolved_text: A fleshy cap spreads above a short stem. Fine gills fold into the shaded underside.

blueprints.name: DriedMeat
blueprints.resolved_text: Salted strips that travel well, until their smell finds company. Drop or throw it onto ground a hunting furrowstalker can see, then stay out of sight. It may stop to eat once during that hunt. Approaching it can still provoke an attack; throwing meat at it is an attack.

blueprints.name: Weaponsmith
blueprints.resolved_text: Forearms like bridge cables. The ring of the forge follows them around.

blueprints.name: Armorer
blueprints.resolved_text: Measures you with a glance and starts thinking in buckles and plates.

blueprints.name: Apothecary
blueprints.resolved_text: Smells of forty herbs at once. Knows which twelve could kill you.

blueprints.name: Arcanist
blueprints.resolved_text: Ink-stained fingers, a shelf of humming grimoires, and prices to match.

blueprints.name: Provisioner
blueprints.resolved_text: Sacks, jars, bundles, barrels. If it keeps on a shelf, they stock it.

blueprints.name: CaveHermit
blueprints.resolved_text: An old soul grown half into the moss. Keeps a kettle on for travelers.

blueprints.name: DesertHermit
blueprints.resolved_text: Sun-cured and patient. They say the dunes talk to those who stop hurrying.

blueprints.name: JungleHermit
blueprints.resolved_text: Fingers stained green and black. Knows every leaf that kills and every leaf that saves.

blueprints.name: RuinsHermit
blueprints.resolved_text: Tends a lamp older than the ruins around it. Remembers what the stones forgot.

blueprints.name: LoanerDagger
blueprints.resolved_text: A serviceable short blade with a repeatedly wrapped grip. Several hands have worn the same places smooth.

blueprints.name: LoanerSpear
blueprints.resolved_text: A plain spear with a carefully reseated head. Marks on the shaft stop where a steady grip begins.

blueprints.name: LoanerLongsword
blueprints.resolved_text: A long sword kept in working order through repeated sharpening. Older wear remains beneath the newer edge.

blueprints.name: Warhammer
blueprints.resolved_text: A dense striking head is fixed across a long handle. The face is narrower than the mass behind it.

blueprints.name: ChoirSpine
blueprints.resolved_text: A stiff spine of bone narrows to a piercing tip. The thicker end is smooth enough to grip.

blueprints.name: OldWorldPipe
blueprints.resolved_text: A length of old metal pipe, hollow at both ends. One end has been battered flatter than the other.

blueprints.name: Sporeblade
blueprints.resolved_text: Fine fungal patterns spread over the blade. The sharpened edge cuts a clean line through them.

blueprints.name: FlamingSword
blueprints.resolved_text: The steel blade has a heat-darkened finish near the guard. A broad crosspiece separates the edge from the grip.

blueprints.name: IceSword
blueprints.resolved_text: Pale steel catches the light along a long, straight edge. The guard curves clear of the hand.

blueprints.name: CryoLance
blueprints.resolved_text: A narrow steel point extends well beyond its reinforced socket. The grip is set behind a small protective collar.

blueprints.name: EmberSpear
blueprints.resolved_text: A steel spearhead draws into a long point. Dark bands mark the metal close to its socket.

blueprints.name: AcidicDagger
blueprints.resolved_text: The short steel blade is etched around its sharpened point. A close guard keeps the grip clear of the working edge.

blueprints.name: VenomDagger
blueprints.resolved_text: A slender dagger with a narrow channel alongside the point. Its grip is well separated from the blade.

blueprints.name: ThunderHammer
blueprints.resolved_text: A dense steel head sits across a long handle. Bright metal shows through the worn striking faces.

blueprints.name: EchoKnife
blueprints.resolved_text: A thin crystal blade catches light in fine internal lines. Its short grip leaves the cutting edge clear.

blueprints.name: SeveranceEdge
blueprints.resolved_text: A long blade with an unbroken sweep from shoulder to point. Its substantial weight gathers forward of the guard.

blueprints.name: GlassblownStiletto
blueprints.resolved_text: Glass narrows to an exceptionally fine point. Tiny changes in thickness bend the view through it.

blueprints.name: DissolutionMaul
blueprints.resolved_text: A broad steel head sits on a haft made for both hands. Shallow pits mark the metal around its striking faces.

blueprints.name: FirstRootGlaive
blueprints.resolved_text: The long wooden haft and curved edge share a continuous grain. Fine living fibers remain beneath the worked surface.

blueprints.name: PalimpsestBlade
blueprints.resolved_text: Old strokes and newer sharpening marks cross the steel. Repeated polishing has left only fragments of the decoration.

blueprints.name: PruningWrit
blueprints.resolved_text: A single page, wax-sealed, the Concord's counting-house hand. The clause is short: the tendrils at the grove edges are to be pruned to the surveyed line by the posted date. A margin note, initialed: post where the grove can read it.

blueprints.name: MarlbackWallkeeper
blueprints.resolved_text: Layers of dark shale broaden this marlback’s back above a patched digging harness. It keeps a long cutting tool ready beside the low wall of its burrow.

blueprints.name: MarlbackBreacher
blueprints.resolved_text: Heavy shale plates crowd the shoulders of this blunt-faced marlback. It carries a wedge-cleaver made for splitting roots and swings its weight forward with each stubborn step.

blueprints.name: BreacherCleaver
blueprints.resolved_text: A salvaged wedge-blade lashed to a short haft. Shale grit fills its binding; the broad edge is worn from splitting roots and breaking packed banks.

blueprints.name: MendleafPlant
blueprints.resolved_text: Soft silver-veined leaves that close when it rains. The herbalists strip them gently; the rotlings just eat the whole plant.

blueprints.name: Cactus
blueprints.resolved_text: A thick, ribbed stem carries close ranks of spines. The folds leave narrow shadows between them.

blueprints.name: Bush
blueprints.resolved_text: Low branches and leaves form a close tangle near the ground.

blueprints.name: Pillar
blueprints.resolved_text: A solid stone shaft occupies the space between its broad foot and the structure above.

blueprints.name: BrokenColumn
blueprints.resolved_text: The surviving section ends in an irregular break. Its fallen pieces have settled around the base.

blueprints.name: Campfire
blueprints.resolved_text: Stones mark a place for a fire. Ash has collected between them.

blueprints.name: WoodenBarrel
blueprints.resolved_text: Curved wooden staves meet beneath tight hoops. The rim is polished where hands have tipped the barrel.

blueprints.name: WaterPuddle
blueprints.resolved_text: A shallow spread of water follows the low places in the ground.

blueprints.name: OilSlick
blueprints.resolved_text: A dark film of oil lies over the ground, drawing into thicker beads along the uneven edges.

blueprints.name: AcidPool
blueprints.resolved_text: A sharp-smelling pool lies in a shallow depression. A pale line marks its edge.

blueprints.name: Reeds
blueprints.resolved_text: Jointed stems stand close together, with narrow leaves folded along their sides.

blueprints.name: Bank
blueprints.resolved_text: A strip of ground follows the water. Small ridges mark where the edge has stood before.

blueprints.name: OilSeep
blueprints.resolved_text: Dark oil has gathered around a narrow opening in the ground. Its heavier folds barely move.

blueprints.name: CompassStoneNorth
blueprints.display_name: compass stone pointing north toward the Ruins of Sparkwright

blueprints.name: CompassStoneEast
blueprints.display_name: compass stone pointing east toward the Saltglass Dunes

blueprints.name: CompassStoneSouth
blueprints.display_name: compass stone pointing south toward the Verdant Rotbog

blueprints.name: CompassStoneWest
blueprints.display_name: compass stone pointing west toward the Frostfang Grotto

blueprints.name: LanternOil
blueprints.resolved_text: A stoppered flask of fuel oil. The outside is rubbed clean where a hand grips it.

blueprints.name: RawMeat
blueprints.resolved_text: Fresh flesh; useful food, or a costly distraction. Drop or throw it onto ground a hunting furrowstalker can see, then stay out of sight. It may stop to eat once during that hunt. Approaching it can still provoke an attack; throwing meat at it is an attack.

blueprints.name: CookedMeat
blueprints.resolved_text: A portion of meat browned at the edges. The surface has tightened around the softer middle.

blueprints.name: RoastedStarapple
blueprints.resolved_text: Heat has wrinkled the skin and softened the flesh beneath it. A little juice has dried along the split.

blueprints.name: Torch
blueprints.resolved_text: A wooden shaft supports a tightly gathered head of fuel. The lower end leaves room for a hand away from the flame.

blueprints.name: CampfireGroundMarker
blueprints.resolved_text: Repeated fires have darkened this patch of earth. Fine ash has worked into the cracks.

blueprints.name: Well
blueprints.resolved_text: Hands and hauled ropes have polished the rim. The water lies below.

blueprints.name: WellGroundMarker
blueprints.resolved_text: Flagstones beneath the drawing place are worn into shallow channels by spilled water.

blueprints.name: MarketStall
blueprints.resolved_text: A counter gives someone a place to set out goods. Trading belongs to whoever tends it.

blueprints.name: SilverSand
blueprints.resolved_text: Fine, pale grains flash as they move. Settled together, they look duller than a single grain does.

blueprints.name: StillleafFileCabinet
blueprints.resolved_text: A salt-sealed drawer beside the Indexer's desk, its lead-line pressed into the lid: "Keeping is not the same as showing." Curation's files open for the words, or not at all.

blueprints.name: LockedDoor
blueprints.resolved_text: Wooden panels surround a fitted lock. The hinges and keyhole have received more care than the face of the door.

blueprints.name: LockedChest
blueprints.resolved_text: A lock plate is set into the front of this wooden chest. Scratches gather around the keyhole.

blueprints.name: SpareIronKey
blueprints.resolved_text: A shop-cut spare for ordinary iron locks. Bound doors and the Stillleaf keeper's lock need their own keys.

blueprints.name: StillleafKey
blueprints.resolved_text: A long iron key, its bow worn smooth by one hand over many years. A Curation file tag still hangs from it: filed with the keeper of Stillleaf.

blueprints.name: StillleafRegister
blueprints.resolved_text: A bound register in pale covers, the name Stillleaf pressed into its spine. It lists what this archive held — shelf, hand and year for every entry — and nothing of what the entries said. A slate is tied to the cover in the keeper's hand: 'Whoever carries this out: I sealed this place so that it would stay sealed. Not because what is here is dangerous. Because it was given to me to keep, and keeping is not the same as showing. If you take it, choose who holds it after you as carefully as I chose no one.'

blueprints.name: Graveyard
blueprints.resolved_text: Low mounds in rows, each marked with a stone or a stick. Someone keeps this ground; the newest earth is still dark.

blueprints.name: Oven
blueprints.resolved_text: A deep baking chamber sits behind a narrow mouth. Soot has settled where the heat passes out.

blueprints.name: OvenGroundMarker
blueprints.resolved_text: A scatter of soot works its way into the joints between the stones.

blueprints.name: FireClay
blueprints.resolved_text: Dense clay that keeps the shape pressed into it. It is used to patch fired well linings and cracked batch pans.

blueprints.name: WatchLantern
blueprints.resolved_text: A guarded lamp with a broad base, made to stand at a place people return to.

blueprints.name: LanternGroundMarker
blueprints.resolved_text: The stone beneath the lantern bears old splashes and the scuffs of people stopping beside it.

blueprints.name: WardOil
blueprints.resolved_text: A measured portion of oil kept for the settlement watch lamps. A dark residue rings the mouth of its container.

blueprints.name: SpikeTrap
blueprints.resolved_text: A bed of pointed spikes is joined to a pressure mechanism. Narrow seams separate the moving plate from its frame.

blueprints.name: FireTrap
blueprints.resolved_text: A small pressure mechanism sits above a fuel outlet. Soot has gathered around the opening.

blueprints.name: BearTrap
blueprints.resolved_text: Curved metal jaws meet around a central pressure plate. The hinge is heavier than the teeth.

blueprints.name: PressurePlate
blueprints.resolved_text: A fitted plate sits slightly apart from its surround. A narrow linkage disappears beneath its edge.

blueprints.name: GlowQuartzVein
blueprints.resolved_text: A seam of light-hoarding quartz. It hums faintly when you stand close.

blueprints.name: PaleSaltVein
blueprints.resolved_text: Crystallized white salt threaded through the limestone. The dead are said to hate it.

blueprints.name: ChoirIronVein
blueprints.resolved_text: Dark ore that rings like a struck bell when chipped. The Rot Choir prizes it.

blueprints.name: PaleSalt
blueprints.resolved_text: Pale crystals leave a dry dust wherever they rest. The Curation values things that resist decay, including its supplies.

blueprints.name: ChoirIron
blueprints.resolved_text: Heavy ore with an uneven, dark metallic grain. Small reddish crumbs gather along its fractured edges.

blueprints.name: WildBerries
blueprints.resolved_text: A handful of small berries, some still carrying the fine stems they grew on.

blueprints.name: Honeycomb
blueprints.resolved_text: Thin wax walls divide the comb into close cells. Honey clings to the broken edges.

blueprints.name: BerryBush
blueprints.resolved_text: Wild berries cluster among the leaves. The fruit can be gathered.

blueprints.name: Beehive
blueprints.resolved_text: Wax cells crowd the inside. Some hold honey.

blueprints.name: MushroomRing
blueprints.resolved_text: Fungal caps trace a loose ring in the ground. Small new heads crowd beneath the older ones.

blueprints.name: Signpost
blueprints.resolved_text: A weathered post with arms pointing off toward places. Fresh cuts cross the old grain.

blueprints.name: GlowQuartz
blueprints.resolved_text: Pale crystal faces catch and carry a nearby gleam. The interior breaks it into smaller points.

blueprints.name: PoisonGasGrenade
blueprints.resolved_text: A sealed canister marked for poison vapor. Throwing it releases its contents into the surrounding air.

blueprints.name: SleepGasGrenade
blueprints.resolved_text: A sealed canister marked for sleep vapor. The cloud released by a throw is not confined to the struck creature.

blueprints.name: StunGasGrenade
blueprints.resolved_text: A sealed canister marked for stun vapor. Its charge is meant to spread through the air after a throw.

blueprints.name: Crate
blueprints.resolved_text: Boards enclose a cargo space. Its corners bear the marks of lifting and stacking.

blueprints.name: Sack
blueprints.resolved_text: Coarse cloth is gathered at the mouth. The folds conceal whatever has been packed inside.

blueprints.name: Urn
blueprints.resolved_text: A clay vessel with a rounded shoulder and narrow mouth. Its thick rim is smoother than the body.

blueprints.name: StrongBox
blueprints.resolved_text: Iron plates enclose a compact box. The lid meets a close-set lock plate.

blueprints.name: OreCache
blueprints.resolved_text: Rough mineral fragments have been gathered into a sheltered recess. Finer dust fills the spaces between them.

blueprints.name: BoneCache
blueprints.resolved_text: Bones have been fitted into a compact pile. Narrow gaps run beneath the larger pieces.

blueprints.name: WovenBasket
blueprints.resolved_text: A close weave rises to a stiff rim, making a light container for things that need carrying.

blueprints.name: HollowLog
blueprints.resolved_text: The centre of the wood is hollow. The opening leaves room to store small things inside.

blueprints.name: Reliquary
blueprints.resolved_text: A carefully fitted case with a lock across its opening. The care taken over the outside says little about what remains inside.

blueprints.name: Bookshelf
blueprints.resolved_text: A shelf lying on its face. Whatever books it held have swollen into one grey block of pulp, but people still tuck things behind the boards.

blueprints.name: WeaponRack
blueprints.resolved_text: Wooden rests are spaced to keep hafts and blades apart. Repeated lifting has polished their upper edges.

blueprints.name: AlchemyShelf
blueprints.resolved_text: A wooden shelf with narrow compartments and circular stains where vessels have stood.

blueprints.name: CopperPipe
blueprints.resolved_text: Runs overhead and underfoot. Charge takes it and keeps going.

blueprints.name: BrinePool
blueprints.resolved_text: Salt water. Conducts better than fresh and freezes later.

blueprints.name: RustedRailing
blueprints.resolved_text: Corroded, but iron still carries a charge.

blueprints.name: TarSeep
blueprints.resolved_text: Slow, thick and very willing to burn.

blueprints.name: DryBrush
blueprints.resolved_text: Catches from almost nothing and burns out fast.

blueprints.name: AshBed
blueprints.resolved_text: Still hot. Water poured on it comes back up as steam.

blueprints.name: PeatBog
blueprints.resolved_text: Wet AND flammable — the one tile that answers to either school.

blueprints.name: FrostVent
blueprints.resolved_text: Breathes cold. Standing water near it will not stay liquid.

blueprints.name: IceSheet
blueprints.resolved_text: Frozen water still carries a charge — and it is brittle.

blueprints.name: SteamVent
blueprints.resolved_text: Wet and hot at once. Carries charge like the water it came from.

blueprints.name: HaulBarrel
blueprints.resolved_text: Oak, banded, and full of something. It will not go in a pack, but it will go across a floor.

blueprints.name: MillStone
blueprints.resolved_text: A wheel of grey stone with a square hole through the middle. Off its spindle it is just a very heavy circle.

blueprints.name: SmithAnvil
blueprints.resolved_text: Not hard to move because it is heavy. Hard to move because there is nowhere to hold it.

blueprints.name: StoneCoffer
blueprints.resolved_text: A lidded box cut from one block. Whoever put it here did not expect it to leave.

blueprints.name: FallenBeam
blueprints.resolved_text: A roof timber, down and lying where it landed. One end is charred.

blueprints.name: SaltCuredBody
blueprints.resolved_text: Kept, and heavy with it. The salt has taken up residence in every part that used to be soft.

blueprints.name: Hedge
blueprints.resolved_text: A wall of hawthorn and bramble, laid and woven by somebody's grandparents. It marks a boundary that no longer has a court to argue it.

blueprints.name: CropRow
blueprints.resolved_text: Cut emberwheat stubble in an old field strip. The grain has already been gathered.

blueprints.name: RipeCropRow
blueprints.resolved_text: A few ripe emberwheat heads stand above the cut rows. Gather this gleaning by hand; the stubble will remain.

blueprints.name: RoadStone
blueprints.resolved_text: Packed earth over old stone, rutted by cartwheels. It goes somewhere, which is more than most things here do.

blueprints.name: CharmFlowers
blueprints.resolved_text: Pale bells on thin stems, growing where nobody sowed them. They are said to keep. Nobody in the Spread can tell you what they keep away.

blueprints.name: FlowerField
blueprints.resolved_text: Petals someone hummed up for the season, a carved token half-buried underneath for whichever river-god still gets the offerings here. It won't last.

blueprints.name: RiverShrine
blueprints.resolved_text: A worn stone by the water, carved tokens left in its lap for whichever river-god still gets the offerings here. The Tree is a children's story in a place like this.

blueprints.name: SaltCrust
blueprints.resolved_text: The pan cracked into plates as it dried. The ridges are sharp enough to read by.

blueprints.name: DuneCrest
blueprints.resolved_text: Soft sand stacked steeper than it looks. Easier to go around than over.

blueprints.name: Bones
blueprints.resolved_text: Picked clean and dried white. Whatever it was, it was walking the road.

blueprints.name: SunStriker
blueprints.resolved_text: A big banded lizard basking flat on the crust, all display and speed. It holds its ground like it owns the noon.

blueprints.name: Saltbriar
blueprints.resolved_text: A grey briar that grows where nothing should, its leaves rimed with the pan's own salt. Caravans strip it as they pass.

blueprints.name: GuestClothPole
blueprints.resolved_text: A dark cloth on a straight pole, hung where it can be seen from a long way off. What it offers holds for three days. Anyone following you knows what it means.

blueprints.name: TentRightHost
blueprints.resolved_text: Weathered, unhurried, watching the road the way a well-keeper watches the water level.

blueprints.name: LastCounterSign
blueprints.resolved_text: A planed board in the Concord's neat hand: WE CANNOT GUARANTEE DELIVERY BEYOND THIS POINT. Underneath, older and fainter, the same words twice more.

blueprints.name: CinderholdNoticeBoard
blueprints.resolved_text: A planed board in the Concord's neat hand: SURVEYED LINE AS POSTED. PRUNING BY THE DATE BELOW. The date has been scraped off and rewritten in a fresher ink, and the line beneath it is drawn straighter than the ground it describes.

blueprints.name: SaltMaster
blueprints.resolved_text: White to the elbows. The scales beside the ledger are cleaner than anything else in the camp.

blueprints.name: MirePool
blueprints.resolved_text: Tea-dark and still. It holds what it takes; the bog country is patient that way.

blueprints.name: Duckboard
blueprints.resolved_text: Planks laid on posts over the soft ground, worn smooth down the middle. Some of them answer your weight.

blueprints.name: DeadTree
blueprints.resolved_text: Grey wood standing in the water it drowned in. It kept its shape better than its neighbors.

blueprints.name: PeatBank
blueprints.resolved_text: Cut peat, the tool marks still clean. The bank face is layered like a book nobody meant to write.

blueprints.name: BogTakenBody
blueprints.resolved_text: A body the peat kept. Tanned dark as the water that took it; the knot in its cloak-cord is still a knot. It was not buried. It fell, and the bog wrote it down.

blueprints.name: PreFellingBody
blueprints.resolved_text: Older than the peat that holds it, and whole to the fingernails. A tin tag on waxed cord, Palimpsest work: 'Recension XI. Body-reading yields: leaf-light through high rooms; a name spoken to a tree, and answered. Reading incomplete.' The attribution is the expedition's. The body says nothing.

blueprints.name: Reedfrog
blueprints.resolved_text: Fat, green, and unbothered until you are close enough to matter. The peat-cutters render them for lamp oil and know which pools they breed in, and guard that knowing like money.

blueprints.name: Bandfrog
blueprints.resolved_text: Banded scarlet over black, and the bands are not decoration. Everything in the bog knows not to touch it; the lesson is the skin.

blueprints.name: MawToad
blueprints.resolved_text: Mostly mouth. It sits where the dead trees stand in the water and it does not chase, because it has never needed to.

blueprints.name: Greatdew
blueprints.resolved_text: A bent stem strung with beads of something clearer than water. The beads do not fall. What it holds, it holds gently, and for exactly as long as it pleases; what it lets go walks away thinner.

blueprints.name: FrogOil
blueprints.resolved_text: Rendered fat in a stoppered gourd. Spread it onto nearby ground to leave slippery grease for eight turns. It can trip a pursuer or your own feet, and catches fire. Silver sand gives firm footing over the slick.

blueprints.name: BoatFrame
blueprints.resolved_text: A hull upside-down on trestles, ribs bare, seams waiting for pitch. Sumphold builds shallow and wide, for water that is mostly patience.

blueprints.name: TollRolls
blueprints.resolved_text: Bound crossing-counts under a rain-hood, a century deep and mould-spotted: carts, heads, coin, initials. One entry is pressed harder than the rest of its year: short count -- forgiven -- my error. The rolls do not record a face.

blueprints.name: SurveyStake
blueprints.resolved_text: A numbered stake, paint gone grey. The numbering starts somewhere out of sight and does not appear to be close to done.

blueprints.name: ReadingTable
blueprints.resolved_text: A long table under canvas, scrubbed pale. Straps, padded blocks, a folio stand: everything arranged so a body may be read without being moved more than it must be. The attending junior's stool sits where the light is worst.

blueprints.name: RecensionScribe
blueprints.resolved_text: Ink to the second knuckle, and a table of attributions never out of reach. Reads everything twice; asserts almost nothing.

blueprints.name: StillleafSearcher
blueprints.resolved_text: A Recension Searcher, ink to the wrist like any scribe, but her table holds old survey maps instead of an attribution list. She reads catalogue fragments the way other people read letters from home.

blueprints.name: CurationSorter
blueprints.resolved_text: Gloves, always. A ledger of numbered things, each entry ending in the same word. Handles everything as if it were on loan, which, per the files, it is.

blueprints.name: StillleafIndexer
blueprints.resolved_text: A Pale Curation Indexer. Gloves to the elbow, a ledger open at the day's page, every entry led by a sentence somebody said last. They will argue a transcription for a week and file the argument.

blueprints.name: PeatCutter
blueprints.resolved_text: Boots to the thigh and a blade like a long spade worn to a shine. Smells of smoke that never quite goes out.

blueprints.name: SealedBogTakenBody
blueprints.resolved_text: Wrapped, waxed, and corded to Curation intake standard; the sorter's stamp is in the seal. The label, in a careful hand: one entry. Status: continuing. It is heavier than it looks, and it looks heavy.

blueprints.name: FilerClerk
blueprints.resolved_text: The intake window of Marrowstye is a person at a table, and the person is this one. Stamps in a row, wax in a warmer, and a ledger whose every entry ends the same way.

blueprints.name: MycelialColumn
blueprints.resolved_text: A column of pale growth, waist-thick and faintly warm, veined violet under the skin. The light in the veins moves slowly, always in the same direction. It holds up nothing. It is not for holding up.

blueprints.name: GroveSeep
blueprints.resolved_text: Clean water rising cold through white filaments, clearer than any well in the towns. The sign says it is for you. Nothing here has ever said otherwise.

blueprints.name: FruitingBody
blueprints.resolved_text: Growth in shelves and closed fists, violet over ochre. It was not this size last season. It will not be this size next season.

blueprints.name: SinkholeLip
blueprints.resolved_text: Undercut rock at the rim, wet with spray from below. The green here grows thicker than the green anywhere else in the chunk, and leans in.

blueprints.name: SubstrateVault
blueprints.resolved_text: Not stone. The wall here was grown, in the way a bone is grown, and it is faintly warm where you rest a hand on it. Threads run through the violet in it, all of them going the same way.

blueprints.name: ChoirNode
blueprints.resolved_text: Where every thread in the vault gathers and does not stop. The light off it is steady, and slow, and has the rhythm of something breathing very deeply somewhere a long way off.

blueprints.name: EncasedElder
blueprints.resolved_text: A person, held. The substrate has taken everything below the shoulders and most of what was above them, and the face it has left is composed, and turned slightly toward you, and has been for a very long time.

blueprints.name: HearthPatch
blueprints.resolved_text: Mature fungus in a low mound, breathing light the colour of new leaves. It is warm the way a body is warm. Everything in this room is arranged around it, and everyone in this room is watching you look at it.

blueprints.name: NicheHome
blueprints.resolved_text: A cell carved into the wall face, bedding folded at the back, a lamp-hook above. Someone sleeps here now and will be laid here later. It is not morbid. It is home.

blueprints.name: PlaqueWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Cut names, row on row, oldest at the floor. The village's history is not written down anywhere else; it is this wall.

blueprints.name: DroseraRing
blueprints.resolved_text: Tended sundew, planted in a ring and kept that way. It catches what walks in and it is not sentimental about it.

blueprints.name: BeetleJar
blueprints.resolved_text: A stoppered jar of lantern-beetles, hung at head height. They brighten when the room moves. Crush one and every Warden in the village will know inside a breath.

blueprints.name: PebbleSundewThreshold
blueprints.resolved_text: A tended field of small sundews across the entry, kept trimmed to ankle height. Stepping across is how the village is introduced to you.

blueprints.name: PlaqueRiane
blueprints.resolved_text: RIANE. Patch-Tender. Widowed the year the green light came back. Tended forty years. Says the patch sang once, and no one believes her, and she does not care.

blueprints.name: PlaqueOssu
blueprints.resolved_text: OSSU. Beetle-Master. Went upstairs young and came back old and never said. Good hands. The wall keeps him anyway.

blueprints.name: PlaqueMerrin
blueprints.resolved_text: MERRIN, called MOTH. Child. One winter. The light dimmed the night she went and the old people say it was courtesy.

blueprints.name: PlaqueSmoothed
blueprints.resolved_text: — — — — — The stone here has been chiselled back to smooth. Nothing is cut into it, and the cutting that was there has been taken out to the depth of a thumbnail.

blueprints.name: PlaqueVashti
blueprints.resolved_text: VASHTI. Tongue. Spoke for the village to three Factors, two Curators, and once, badly, to a god. First Plaque cut at twelve; died at ninety-one; the plaque she cut at twelve is behind this one, and it says, in a child's letters: I WILL SLEEP HERE WHEN I AM DONE. SAVE MY PLACE.

blueprints.name: PlaqueOldest
blueprints.resolved_text: The letters here are worn beyond the alphabet. Whatever this row says, it has stopped saying it in any language now in use.

blueprints.name: CatacombWarden
blueprints.resolved_text: Broad through the shoulders, pale as the walls, and standing where the light from the patch falls across the entry. She has been watching you since the sundew.

blueprints.name: PlaqueTender
blueprints.resolved_text: Old, and holding a lamp low to the bottom rows. Her hands are chalked white to the wrist from re-cutting letters that were going soft.

blueprints.name: DescentLedge
blueprints.resolved_text: A shelf of rock wide enough to stand on and not much wider. Water finds it, uses it, and goes on down.

blueprints.name: SariSnake
blueprints.resolved_text: A heavy pit viper the colour of wet stone, coiled where the litter is deepest. It does not rattle and it does not flee. Where these are thick on a slope, something underneath is awake.

blueprints.name: Wardline
blueprints.resolved_text: A long olive colubrid draped along a branch, watching the ground with more attention than it spends on you. Villages that have one nearby say so the way other places mention a good well.

blueprints.name: CascadeFather
blueprints.resolved_text: A thumbnail of a frog, pale-striped, sitting in the spray with a back full of young. It has no call. Where the water is good, they are everywhere; where the water has gone wrong, they are the first thing missing.

blueprints.name: GlasspaneFrog
blueprints.resolved_text: Its underside is a window. You can watch the heart work from here, which is a thing it cannot hide from you and does not seem to mind. The Bower-Folk pay for these alive and unbruised.

blueprints.name: YellowfootWayfarer
blueprints.resolved_text: A tortoise the size of a footstool, going somewhere at its own rate. Some villages have kept one for six generations and treat it as the oldest thing that remembers them.

blueprints.name: TepuiStone
blueprints.resolved_text: Pink-grey sandstone, worn smooth and faintly warm underfoot. Every tepui in the world is the Tree's anatomy turned to stone; this one is the stump itself, and you are standing on it.

blueprints.name: TepuiWall
blueprints.resolved_text: A shoulder of pink stone standing out of the slope. The grain in it runs the same way the grain runs everywhere here, which is how you know the whole mountain is one object.

blueprints.name: GrainRidge
blueprints.resolved_text: A ridge of pink-grey stone with the grain of wood in it, running the way every other ridge on this mountain runs. It is not like wood. It is wood, finished with being wood.

blueprints.name: StoneDome
blueprints.resolved_text: A dome of pink stone, smooth as a knuckle. It was a bough once, or the knot where a bough met the trunk. The scrub grows in its cracks and does not ask.

blueprints.name: TankBrocchinia
blueprints.resolved_text: A bromeliad the size of a rain barrel, holding a barrel's worth of rain. The water is clear and cold and something small lives its entire life in there. Summit people drink from these and leave the small thing unbothered.

blueprints.name: SprayPool
blueprints.resolved_text: Falling water lands here and stands a while, cold and bright, before it finds the next shelf down. Things live in it that live nowhere drier.

blueprints.name: RopeAnchor
blueprints.resolved_text: An iron pin driven into the rock, and a hand's length of rope still knotted to it. The cut end is old and clean: somebody took the rest with them, or somebody took it from them.

blueprints.name: BloomingFruitingBody
blueprints.resolved_text: Growth in shelves and closed fists, brighter than its neighbors, and warm. It is further along than the others. Standing near it feels like being considered.

blueprints.name: GroveSign
blueprints.resolved_text: A board of grown wood, the letters raised in living grain — grown out of it, not carved into it — and weathered smooth by hands. It reads: WALKER. YOU ARE ENTERING US. Walk anywhere. Everything is path. Drink at the seep. It is for you. Eat nothing red. The red is thinking. If you hear singing, it is old singing. It is not for you. You may listen anyway. The singers do not mind. The singers have not minded anything for a long time, and it is a kindness to be heard. Do not dig. If you are tired — truly tired, walker, the kind of tired that has stopped keeping count — lie down anywhere soft. Someone will cover you. If you are only a little tired, keep walking. We can tell the difference. We are patient about the difference. GO GENTLY. EVERYTHING HERE IS SOMEBODY.

blueprints.name: WovenDoll
blueprints.resolved_text: No longer than a hand. The column beside it has grown around one arm, and stopped.

blueprints.name: CompostRow
blueprints.resolved_text: A tidy row of what is being taken back: cloth gone to lace, a boot, chitin, a shape further along than the rest. The rows are straight. Nothing made them straight; they grew that way. Everything here is somebody.

blueprints.name: GroveRedGrowth
blueprints.resolved_text: Low growth heavy with red, at the grove edge, where the sign can see it. The sign says eat nothing red. Nothing stops you picking it.

blueprints.name: Shambler
blueprints.resolved_text: It was somebody's shape once, and the growth kept the shape because the shape still walked. Before lashing, it draws one tendril straight back. The lash follows that line for two paces; the body hangs loose while the tendril gathers again.

blueprints.name: GroveLanternMoth
blueprints.resolved_text: A hand-sized moth with broad translucent wings, each crossed by three soft bars of pale grove-light. It navigates by the columns; the glow is dust on its wings.

blueprints.name: WineLeafSundew
blueprints.resolved_text: Leaves the color of wine going darker, beaded sticky at every edge. How dark the leaves are is how recently it has eaten. These are quite dark.

blueprints.name: CompostCache
blueprints.resolved_text: A spot in the row where the taking-back has further to go. Some of what comes up still has pockets. The grove does not mind; it was never after the pockets.

blueprints.name: SummitSinger
blueprints.resolved_text: A small brown frog with a dark W folded across its back. It waits against a mossy trunk, throat lifted. One note, then another. The long space between them seems to belong to the mountain.

blueprints.name: BrocchiniaSentinel
blueprints.resolved_text: A lichen-coloured lizard flattened against the stone. Its green-brown flanks repeat the mottling of the dome so closely that the yellow eye seems to hang there alone. Tank leaves shiver close by.

blueprints.name: SkySari
blueprints.resolved_text: An immense ash-pale eagle, dark beneath the wings. Its talons close slowly on nothing. People who know the slopes watch the ground when this shadow crosses them: what coils below and what circles above have begun keeping the same hours.

blueprints.name: PrickleBrowGecko
blueprints.resolved_text: An indigo gecko with an amber throat and a long fine spine above each eye. It holds itself close to the litter, all sharp elbows and patient attention. Several small tracks meet beneath the stone beside it.

blueprints.name: HelmwoodFrog
blueprints.resolved_text: A broad-headed forest frog with a bony casque like a weathered wooden helm. A bead of water clings below its jaw. Underground, such a visitor is worth following: forest frogs do not arrive in sealed rooms.

blueprints.name: PricklebrowNest
blueprints.resolved_text: Sixteen pale eggs share a hollow under the leaf litter. Blue-black brows watch from the surrounding cracks. A foot in that hollow would have many answers.

blueprints.name: TepuiboneVein
blueprints.resolved_text: A pale seam holds its line through the pink-grey stone. The mountain remembers a grain older than rock. Even a loose chip seems unwilling to be lifted.

blueprints.name: Tepuibone
blueprints.resolved_text: Sandstone cut from the Root. It weighs more than its size promises, pale grain closed tightly around the memory of wood. Name-holders work it patiently; the stone has never been in a hurry.

blueprints.name: MemoryMarble
blueprints.resolved_text: A chip of memory-marble worked loose from an archive wall: the Palimpsest's writing-surface, which holds what is written on it harder than the hand that wrote it. One of the three stones that hold their names hardest, and so one of the three that could hold the Root still.

blueprints.name: MuteStone
blueprints.resolved_text: Mute-stone, pale grey and warm nowhere. The death-watch is kept in chambers of it because it does not answer, and what does not answer cannot be unsaid. One of the three stones that hold their names hardest, and so one of the three that could hold the Root still.

blueprints.name: ChoirCutting
blueprints.resolved_text: A living thread of the Choir, cut and given, warm and faintly moving in the hand. Set against the sleeping Root it would take, the way water takes the way to the sea, and the Choir would reach what it has walked toward for a thousand years: nothing lost, no one left. It hums one syllable, patiently.

blueprints.name: HelmwoodWaterPassage
blueprints.resolved_text: Fresh water runs through a low opening worn smooth in the stone. The current comes from farther away than this pool can explain. Stand here and follow it downward (>) or upward (<).

blueprints.name: TheRooted
blueprints.resolved_text: A human shape has grown into the stone: shins flat, knees bent, torso arched above the floor. Pale fungus rises from his chest. His open arms reach toward the eastern wall and stop short of it. Nothing has been built in that narrow distance. The pose holds no strain.

blueprints.name: FoundingPlume
blueprints.resolved_text: Pale stalks rise from the Rooted's torso and spread into a soft, warm bed. Every hearth in Olderdeep grew outward from this body. Those trusted by the Listening Tradition may lie here and sleep.

blueprints.name: FoundingListener
blueprints.resolved_text: She rests one hand against the chamber wall as she listens. Her voice reaches you at the same volume as her breathing.

blueprints.name: FoundingPlaqueTender
blueprints.resolved_text: Stone dust whitens her knees. She deepens an old inscription one small cut at a time, pausing to speak toward the floor between cuts.

blueprints.name: FellingScar
blueprints.resolved_text: A shallow arc in the pink-grey grain, rounded as a crease in an old hand. It continues around an open circle.

blueprints.name: FellingBarePosition
blueprints.resolved_text: Bare ground interrupts the circle. No root, moss or filament holds here. Five other patches face the same open space; none carries a name.

blueprints.name: SeventhPosition
blueprints.resolved_text: A seventh interval in the circle. Nothing occupies it. Looking across it, the near and far edges briefly cease to agree. The air is wrong at this one point.

blueprints.name: TheRoot
blueprints.resolved_text: The taproot's face, exposed where the stone gave way: sandstone-pale, warm to a hand laid flat, slower than breathing. It is the last living root of the Tree that held everything, and it is asleep. It dreams. What it dreams, no one who came down here has been able to say.

blueprints.name: LibraryTepuiboneWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Pale stone closes in long courses. Grain turns through the blocks without reaching their edges.

blueprints.name: LibraryMemoryMarbleWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Clouded bands repeat beneath the polished face. The joints are too fine to admit a fingertip.

blueprints.name: LibraryChoirIronWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Dull iron ribs bind the stone courses. Their rivets are set deep; no filament grows in the seams.

blueprints.name: SealedLibraryDoor
blueprints.resolved_text: Iron lies flush within a pale stone frame. A small keyway interrupts the unbroken seam.

blueprints.name: SealedLibraryFloor
blueprints.resolved_text: Close-fitted slabs run between the sealed shelves.

blueprints.name: SealedArchiveShelf
blueprints.resolved_text: Tied bundles stand in shallow stone shelves. Faded clay seals close each binding.

blueprints.name: OverwritGround
blueprints.resolved_text: Smooth ground. No stones break the surface.

blueprints.name: OverwritNewGrowth
blueprints.resolved_text: A few pale shoots. Every tip reaches the same height.

blueprints.name: OverwritWaymarker
blueprints.resolved_text: A short stone at the edge of the blank ground. Its face carries no legible mark.

blueprints.name: OverwritPilgrimBench
blueprints.resolved_text: A plain wooden bench turned toward the empty ground.

blueprints.name: GantryTimberWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Wide weathered boards braced into a low timber wall. Local carpenters replace one section at a time.

blueprints.name: GantryRegistryDesk
blueprints.resolved_text: A broad writing desk, weighted against the crossing wind. This office keeps ordinary road and household records.

blueprints.name: GantryExchangeCounter
blueprints.resolved_text: A portable timber counter with storage beneath its broad trading surface.

blueprints.name: GantryWayboard
blueprints.resolved_text: Exchange and stores; the records office; the caravan rest. Three stout arms point into the public courts of Gantry.

blueprints.name: GantryRegistrar
blueprints.resolved_text: A Pale Curation clerk with wind-flattened sleeves and ordinary ink on both hands. Their work concerns the living: road accounts, tenancy and the careful spelling of names.

blueprints.name: QuillholdArchiveWall
blueprints.resolved_text: Clouded gray marble, fitted around a public reading room. Ordinary joints admit ordinary tools; this is a working archive, not a sealed one.

blueprints.name: QuillholdArchiveShelf
blueprints.resolved_text: Maintained wooden shelves hold tied folios beside their variants. Nothing is written over: additions wait beside the older hands.

blueprints.name: QuillholdCopyDesk
blueprints.resolved_text: A low desk with a sloped folio board and an ink groove. The village scribe makes copies here; the original stays with its bearer.

blueprints.name: QuillholdRefectoryTable
blueprints.resolved_text: A broad, scrubbed table for meals shared between shifts in the archive. The folios stay in the reading rooms; ink-stained hands rest here.
