blueprints.name: Waterskin
blueprints.resolved_text: Holds three drinks. Fill beside a well, cistern or standing fresh water; a drink relieves one layer of parch.

blueprints.name: RoastedMushroom
blueprints.resolved_text: The edges have browned and curled; the flesh inside is still soft.

blueprints.name: SootGremlin
blueprints.resolved_text: A small soot-dark creature with blunt claws and a nose dusted grey from old hearths. It paws through anything left near the cold ash.

blueprints.name: DirtGnome
blueprints.resolved_text: A squat earth-grubber with soil worked into the creases of its skin. Its broad claws have loosened more roots than the farmer cares to count.

blueprints.name: TemperedLongSword
blueprints.resolved_text: A narrow line follows the hardened edge. The tang runs through a plain grip to a peened pommel.

blueprints.name: CounterweightMaul
blueprints.resolved_text: A heavy striking head is balanced by a smaller weight below the grip. Both ends are scarred by use.

blueprints.name: FineRingMail
blueprints.resolved_text: Closely fitted rings lie in shallow folds. Small overlapping links cover the seams beneath each arm.

blueprints.name: RivetedPlate
blueprints.resolved_text: Thick overlapping plates are held by broad rivets. Deep straps carry their weight across the shoulders.

blueprints.name: LiquidFlask
blueprints.resolved_text: Thick glass and a tight stopper. The narrow neck lets you pour without wetting your hands.

blueprints.name: SpreadHurdleCutter
blueprints.resolved_text: A broad marlback with a pale notch cut through one shale back plate. Trained to strike across a two-step gap when armed with a long blade, it watches for a willing ditch mate nearby.

blueprints.name: SpreadDitchMate
blueprints.resolved_text: Parallel rake marks cross this short-faced marlback's shoulder plates. It is accustomed to fighting beside a willing companion; separation and cover can break their coordination. Its cudgel can shove you into obstacles; brace with suitable equipment before its blow, or keep your distance. Bracing stops the shove, not its stun or collision damage.

blueprints.name: SpreadLatchcoil
blueprints.resolved_text: A broken chalk-colored ring follows this viper's low coils. Nearby movement or injury can rouse its ambush; its bite can poison.

blueprints.name: ReedbackGrazer
blueprints.resolved_text: A squat four-footed grazer with a blunt muzzle and a ridge of stiff reed-like hair. Its split hooves pick between the worked rows; it shies from close footsteps.

blueprints.name: ReedbackGrazerCorpse
blueprints.resolved_text: The low reed ridge lies flat against a still, broad body.

blueprints.name: Furrowstalker
blueprints.resolved_text: A low, narrow hunter with a wedge-shaped muzzle and a tapering tail. Its four feet follow the furrows quietly; a pale jaw opens beneath its dark brow.

blueprints.name: FurrowstalkerCorpse
blueprints.resolved_text: A narrow body lies folded over four still feet, its long muzzle resting against the soil.

blueprints.name: SpreadDrawPoint
blueprints.resolved_text: A shallow stone-lined pocket beside the bank. Its collected water can be drawn into a carried vessel; the wet ground around it is not a refill.

blueprints.name: Tatterjay
blueprints.resolved_text: A broad-billed blue-green bird with a pale breast and an uneven fan of tail feathers. It tests loose things with its bill, then tilts its head toward the place where it keeps them.

blueprints.name: TatterjayCorpse
blueprints.resolved_text: The broad bill rests against a pale breast. Uneven tail feathers lie spread across the ground.

blueprints.name: StoneburrPatch
blueprints.resolved_text: Ochre burrs hook together above dark, leathery leaves. Gather the hard seeds and brew them alone for a stoneskin tonic; drinking it briefly blunts incoming blows.

blueprints.name: FrostLichenPatch
blueprints.resolved_text: Pale crusts collect in the cold shade of stones. Gather the lichen and brew it alone into a freezing coating. Quench a melee weapon with the coating beside a forge; drinking it freezes the drinker.

blueprints.name: MarlbackCindercaller
blueprints.resolved_text: A narrow-capped marlback with scorched mantle edges and fire-moss tucked into a pouch. It spits a short gob of fire, then closes with its cudgel while its breath returns. Its partner answers nearby attacks; walls interrupt the spit.

blueprints.name: MarlbackSoursprayer
blueprints.resolved_text: A hooded marlback with a stained throat-wrap and a sealed pouch of glimmer brine. It tries to keep three paces while its short acid spray recovers, and steps sideways to clear an ally from its shot. A nearby partner answers attacks, but stone blocks the spray.

blueprints.name: SpreadSeedKeeper
blueprints.resolved_text: A broad hat shades a row of seed pouches. Ask about planting or trade for seeds and a watering grimoire.

blueprints.name: SpreadWaysideCook
blueprints.resolved_text: A flour-pale cap and a patched apron. Ask about the kitchen, buy a meal, or bring raw food to cook yourself.

blueprints.name: CurationIntakeIndex
blueprints.resolved_text: Two final remarks occupy opposite pages. A tethered stamp rests beside an unissued cabinet counterfoil. Match each salt-cured subject to the bay bearing their last words, release the haul, then check the filing here. Names are cross-references. Last words are labels, not instructions.

blueprints.name: CurationReceivingBay
blueprints.resolved_text: A low chalk-white frame with a slot for a final remark. Haul its corresponding subject onto the marked tile; release the haul before certification.

blueprints.name: CurationToolCabinet
blueprints.resolved_text: Four numbered compartments; one counterfoil-shaped lock. Its label reads: MATERIAL ISSUED FOR CORRECTION. Do not return used salt to the unused account.

blueprints.name: CurationCounterfoil
blueprints.resolved_text: A stiff card whose punched teeth fit Marrowstye's released-tools cabinet. CERTIFIED POSITION, it says. The wording carefully promises nothing else.

blueprints.name: CurationInspectionKey
blueprints.resolved_text: A narrow key with a red cord. The tag warns: DISUSED WING. INCOMPLETE CURE. Unlocking does not make the enclosure safe. Opening releases its occupant.

blueprints.name: CurationTransferGate
blueprints.resolved_text: A pale gate separates the inspection gallery from the empty holding room. Its latch works from either side. Close this gate and the holding room's service gate to enclose an occupant; first get yourself and every loose object clear of the thresholds.

blueprints.name: CurationGalleryGate
blueprints.resolved_text: Salt-white bars interrupt the masonry screen along the south passage. This unlocked maintenance entrance bypasses the keyed inspection door. Opening it gives the half-set a path into the service passage. Close it behind you; an occupied threshold cannot be closed.

blueprints.name: CurationServiceGate
blueprints.resolved_text: The wooden gate has dropped off its lower brace. An open gap connects the holding room to the southern service passage. Two sound lengths from the vestibule maintenance rack can brace the frame. Repair permits ordinary opening and closing; it does not close the gate for you or contain anything by itself.

blueprints.name: CurationRecoveryCabinet
blueprints.resolved_text: Dry supplies survive behind a buckled salt hood: fire clay, work gloves and an imported sumpsieve dressing. The emergency label says: FOR THE PERSON CONDUCTING THE INSPECTION. The stock is finite; the empty cabinet will remain empty.

blueprints.name: CurationConservationCase
blueprints.resolved_text: Two packets of sootroot pulp and a measure of pitchpod resin sit under a salt-tight lid. These are ink ingredients, reserved for the record that was to follow the inspection. The label reads: COMPLETION MATERIALS. DO NOT USE TO COMPLETE THE SUBJECT. The case stands beyond the central slab; its stock will not be replaced.

blueprints.name: CurationMaintenanceRack
blueprints.resolved_text: Two sound lengths were measured for the holding-room service gate. The sign reads: REPAIR AUTHORISED. ENTRY PENDING REPAIR. This rack is on the safe side of the masonry. The measured lengths match the sagging frame beside the southern passage.

blueprints.name: CurationInspectionSlab
blueprints.resolved_text: A stone slab has shallow drainage grooves and a single buckle polished brighter than the others. Older holes show where a second set of restraints was removed. A note in Doreth's hand reads: NO SUBJECT RECEIVED BEFORE DEATH. Beneath it, in a different hand: THIS ALSO APPLIES TO REPLACEMENT SUBJECTS. The remaining straps secure vessels during inspection; they cannot restrain a moving creature for you. Deep tendril marks stop against its stone edge. There is room to pass along either side.

blueprints.name: CurationAnnexPlacard
blueprints.resolved_text: A salt-spotted board carries a maintenance sketch, a supply list and an incomplete intake record. A margin sketch records the growth drawing back before it lashes. The board also marks two holding-room gates and the reason the gallery remains closed.

blueprints.name: CurationSaltBench
blueprints.resolved_text: A sieve stands above two shallow trays. Beneath the clean tray: UNUSED. Beneath the other: USED ONCE, STILL DRY. A blunt rake, measuring scoop and tethered stamp have white outlines showing where to return them. These are the staff's working instruments; the bench offers no preservation service.

blueprints.name: CurationSaltRake
blueprints.resolved_text: A short ash handle ends in a broad comb of blunt iron teeth. It levels salt around awkward joints. Heavy enough to use as a cudgel; it cannot preserve a body by itself.

blueprints.name: CurationQuarantineGate
blueprints.resolved_text: Red cord crosses a barred gate. The plaque reads: INCOMPLETE CURE. MOVEMENT OBSERVED. BLOOM PRESENT. Keep closed. Inspection is optional; opening exposes the public yard. A smaller correction changes SUBJECT RESTLESS to MOTION NOT ATTRIBUTED TO SUBJECT.

blueprints.name: CurationQuarantineRail
blueprints.resolved_text: Close-set iron rails, heavily salted at the base. The gap is too narrow for a person. A fresh pale cord holds yesterday's inspection card.

blueprints.name: CurationTransferDocket
blueprints.resolved_text: A folded receiving copy. Read the salt and carriage accounts; several figures have been carried forward longer than the paper has survived.

blueprints.name: CurationDiscrepancyReport
blueprints.resolved_text: Two case numbers have exchanged columns. A careful hand has noted the error without once crossing out a word of the final remarks.

blueprints.name: CurationIntakeFiler
blueprints.resolved_text: Salt has whitened Doreth's broad apron and settled into the seams of pale gloves. There is a clean patch over each knee. The subjects are handled carefully, whatever the forms call them.

blueprints.name: CurationJuniorIndexer
blueprints.resolved_text: A collar almost reaches Ivrin's ears. Pale gloves hold a ruled board against the chest; its corners have worn the same two places in the coat. The margin contains a very small drawing of a thimble.

blueprints.name: CurationHalfSet
blueprints.resolved_text: Salt covers one shoulder and ends in a damp line across the ribs. Green growth works through the gap; its tendril pulls the human frame after it. An intake tag turns face-in against the chest. This cure was interrupted. The movement is not a response to speech. Before it lashes, a tendril draws straight back. It strikes along that line for two paces, then hangs loose while the tendril gathers again.

blueprints.name: SalvagedTimber
blueprints.resolved_text: Sound lengths sorted out of a fallen frame. Two lengths can brace a jammed wooden gate.

blueprints.name: KnotflaxCord
blueprints.resolved_text: Tough knotflax stems stripped and twisted into cord as they are gathered. One coil can replace a snapped well line.

blueprints.name: Hearthbulb
blueprints.resolved_text: An ochre bulb under a papery, ribbed skin. Edible raw; roasting beside a cooking fire makes a more nourishing meal.

blueprints.name: RoastedHearthbulb
blueprints.resolved_text: The split skin holds a soft, sweet center. A small meal that keeps well in its own wrapper.

blueprints.name: SeamleafSprig
blueprints.resolved_text: Paired thick leaves joined by a pale seam. Their vital sap is a brewing ingredient; the raw leaves are not a healing potion.

blueprints.name: KnotflaxSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: Plant in an empty tilled bed. Conjure Rain waters the crop; dry soil pauses growth. Harvest the ripe plant for two useful units and one seed. Growth happens while you act in this area.

blueprints.name: KnotflaxCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: Blue-green stalks swell at regular knots. Strip and twist the ripe stems while harvesting to make useful cord.

blueprints.name: HearthbulbSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: Plant in an empty tilled bed. Conjure Rain waters the crop; dry soil pauses growth. Harvest the ripe plant for two useful units and one seed. Growth happens while you act in this area.

blueprints.name: HearthbulbCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: Bent leaves shelter ochre bulbs which rise just above the furrow. A food crop for eating or roasting.

blueprints.name: SeamleafSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: Plant in an empty tilled bed. Conjure Rain waters the crop; dry soil pauses growth. Harvest the ripe plant for two useful units and one seed. Growth happens while you act in this area.

blueprints.name: SeamleafCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: Thick paired leaves grow along a pale central seam. White flowers mark the time to gather brewing sprigs.

blueprints.name: RepairLinedWell
blueprints.resolved_text: A shallow catch well beside the growing beds. Its fired-clay lining forms a basin beneath a broad stone rim.

blueprints.name: RepairRopeWell
blueprints.resolved_text: A lifting frame spans this masonry well. A spindle carries the line and bucket above the water below.

blueprints.name: RepairWoodenGate
blueprints.resolved_text: A short timber gate marks the allotment boundary. Cross-braces support its wooden frame around the hinges and latch.

blueprints.name: RepairClayBank
blueprints.resolved_text: Red clay shows where water has undercut the bank. Gather four measures for repairs; the exposed pocket is finite.

blueprints.name: RepairCordBundle
blueprints.resolved_text: Someone left a dry bundle of knotflax on a stone. Strip and twist it into two coils; growing knotflax can supply more.

blueprints.name: ClaspbeanSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: A claspbean seed. Plant it while standing on an empty prepared bed. Conjure Rain keeps its soil moist; dry growth pauses. The ripe crop supplies claspbean pulp. Apply the pulp to stop bleeding.

blueprints.name: ClaspbeanCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: Paired pods close around pale tendrils. Rural hands squeeze their soft pulp onto cuts. The planted crop takes 40 moist rounds to become ripe. Watered crops keep growing while you travel. Harvest by hand, then pick up its claspbean pulp and one saved seed. Apply the pulp to stop bleeding.

blueprints.name: ClaspbeanPulp
blueprints.resolved_text: Apply the pulp to stop bleeding. Paired pods close around pale tendrils. Rural hands squeeze their soft pulp onto cuts.

blueprints.name: PitchpodSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: A pitchpod seed. Plant it while standing on an empty prepared bed. Conjure Rain keeps its soil moist; dry growth pauses. The ripe crop supplies pitchpod resin. Brew the resin into a burning coating, then throw the bottle to ignite a target.

blueprints.name: PitchpodCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: Amber resin beads under the papery pods and sticks stubbornly to the fingers. The planted crop takes 48 moist rounds to become ripe. Watered crops keep growing while you travel. Harvest by hand, then pick up its pitchpod resin and one saved seed. Brew the resin into a burning coating, then throw the bottle to ignite a target.

blueprints.name: PitchpodResin
blueprints.resolved_text: Brew the resin into a burning coating, then throw the bottle to ignite a target. Amber resin beads under the papery pods and sticks stubbornly to the fingers.

blueprints.name: DrawgourdSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: A drawgourd seed. Plant it while standing on an empty prepared bed. Conjure Rain keeps its soil moist; dry growth pauses. The ripe crop supplies drawgourd shell. Fill the empty shell near fresh water; it carries three drinks.

blueprints.name: DrawgourdCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: A narrow neck rises from a hard, smooth shell, the familiar shape of a river-country drinking vessel. The planted crop takes 56 moist rounds to become ripe. Watered crops keep growing while you travel. Harvest by hand, then pick up its drawgourd shell and one saved seed. Fill the empty shell near fresh water; it carries three drinks.

blueprints.name: DrawgourdShell
blueprints.resolved_text: Fill the empty shell near fresh water; it carries three drinks. A narrow neck rises from a hard, smooth shell, the familiar shape of a river-country drinking vessel.

blueprints.name: WickrushSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: A wickrush seed. Plant it while standing on an empty prepared bed. Conjure Rain keeps its soil moist; dry growth pauses. The ripe crop supplies wickrush candle. Equip the candle and light it beside a fire. Extinguish it to save the remaining fuel.

blueprints.name: WickrushCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: Each rush grows its own pale coat of wax around a fibrous wick. The planted crop takes 44 moist rounds to become ripe. Watered crops keep growing while you travel. Harvest by hand, then pick up its wickrush candle and one saved seed. Equip the candle and light it beside a fire. Extinguish it to save the remaining fuel.

blueprints.name: WickrushCandle
blueprints.resolved_text: Equip the candle and light it beside a fire. Extinguish it to save the remaining fuel. Each rush grows its own pale coat of wax around a fibrous wick.

blueprints.name: MarlrootSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: A marlroot seed. Plant it while standing on an empty prepared bed. Conjure Rain keeps its soil moist; dry growth pauses. The ripe crop supplies marlroot clod. Choose Prepare in inventory to separate one clod into fire clay for repairing clay-lined masonry.

blueprints.name: MarlrootCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: Knuckled roots grip a clod of fine red clay tightly enough to bring it up when pulled. The planted crop takes 52 moist rounds to become ripe. Watered crops keep growing while you travel. Harvest by hand, then pick up its marlroot clod and one saved seed. Choose Prepare in inventory to separate one clod into fire clay for repairing clay-lined masonry.

blueprints.name: MarlrootClod
blueprints.resolved_text: Choose Prepare in inventory to separate one clod into fire clay for repairing clay-lined masonry. Knuckled roots grip a clod of fine red clay tightly enough to bring it up when pulled.

blueprints.name: SumpsieveSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: A sumpsieve seed. Plant it while standing on an empty prepared bed. Conjure Rain keeps its soil moist; dry growth pauses. The ripe crop supplies sumpsieve pad. Apply the pad to treat ordinary or lingering gas poison. It does not treat fungal infection or prevent new exposure.

blueprints.name: SumpsieveCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: Peat-cutters keep these bitter, perforated leaves drying on shelves above the damp. The planted crop takes 48 moist rounds to become ripe. Watered crops keep growing while you travel. Harvest by hand, then pick up its sumpsieve pad and one saved seed. Apply the pad to treat ordinary or lingering gas poison. It does not treat fungal infection or prevent new exposure.

blueprints.name: SumpsievePad
blueprints.resolved_text: Apply the pad to treat ordinary or lingering gas poison. It does not treat fungal infection or prevent new exposure. Peat-cutters keep these bitter, perforated leaves drying on shelves above the damp.

blueprints.name: DrowsebellSeed
blueprints.resolved_text: A drowsebell seed. Plant it while standing on an empty prepared bed. Conjure Rain keeps its soil moist; dry growth pauses. The ripe crop supplies drowsebell bladder. Throw the bladder to release sleep vapor. Breathing allies can fall asleep too; damage wakes sleepers.

blueprints.name: DrowsebellCrop
blueprints.resolved_text: The bowed bells swell until their thin skins can scarcely hold the drowsy vapor inside. The planted crop takes 60 moist rounds to become ripe. Watered crops keep growing while you travel. Harvest by hand, then pick up its drowsebell bladder and one saved seed. Throw the bladder to release sleep vapor. Breathing allies can fall asleep too; damage wakes sleepers.

blueprints.name: DrowsebellBladder
